name: SubmitSpecsAssetJobs
modelDescription: Submit one to sixteen SPECS text-to-3D or image-to-3D asset jobs for later collection.

abandonUncertain.description: Give up on retained jobs whose submission outcome is unknown so a new batch can start. A remote generation may already be running for them and will be left to expire. Only set this when a prior result reported errorCode submission_unknown and retrying the same requests did not clear it.

referenceImagePath.description: Absolute path to a PNG, JPEG, or WebP reference image for the initial SPECS image-to-3D submission. Image bytes are read only for that submission.

overwriteExisting.description: Allow the collected GLB to replace a file already at Assets/GeneratedMeshes/<outputName>.glb. Set this in a progressive build that wrote a primitive placeholder to the mesh's final path so the real generation overwrites it in place; otherwise the placeholder reads as an output_conflict and the job never collects. Leave unset for a normal build so the path-collision guard stays in force.
